description.content:
Last Updated July 2025

You can use Oracle REST APIs to view and manage data stored in Oracle Supply Chain Management Cloud.

Whether you're experienced with or new to REST, use this guide to find what you need, including:

  • A quick start that walks you through a simple request example.
  • Detailed descriptions for each REST API resource.

When this parameter is provided, the specified children are included in the resource payload (instead of just a link). The value of this query parameter is "all" or "". More than one child can be specified using comma as a separator. Example: ?expand=Employees,Localizations. Nested children can also be provided following the format "Child.NestedChild" (Example: ?expand=Employees.Managers). If a nested child is provided (Example: Employees.Managers), the missing children will be processed implicitly. For example, "?expand=Employees.Managers" is the same as "?expand=Employees,Employees.Managers" (which will expand Employees and Managers).

This parameter filters the resource fields. Only the specified fields are returned, which means that if no fields are specified, no fields are returned (useful to get only the links). If an indirect child resource is provided (Example: Employees.Managers), the missing children will be processed implicitly. For example, "?fields=Employees.Managers:Empname" is the same as "?fields=;Employees:;Employees.Managers:Empname" (which will only return the "Empname" field for Managers). the value of this query parameter is a list of resource fields. The attribute can be a direct (Example: Employees) or indirect (Example: Employees.Managers) child. It cannot be combined with expand query parameter. If both are provided, only fields will be considered.

Format: ?fields=Attribute1,Attribute2

Format for fields in child resource: ?fields=Accessor1:Attribute1,Attribute2
The resource item payload will be filtered in order to contain only data (no links section, for example).

This parameter specifies dependencies which are fields that are set before and rolled back after generating the response. Generally they are used to preview the effects of an attribute change. The fields specified in this parameter are always set in the resource instance in question. When a child resource collection is requested and the parameter is set, the fields will be set in the parent resource instance before generating the resource collection payload. The value of this query parameter is a set of dependency fields. Example: dependency=ProductId=2

Format: <attr1>=<val1>,<attr2>=<value2>

This parameter can be used to show only certain links while accessing a singular resource or a resource collection. The parameter value format is a comma-separated list of : <link_relation>

Example:
self,canonical
(Required) Value that uniquely identifies the work order. It is a primary key that the application generates when it creates the work order.
(Required) Value that uniquely identifies the rework that references the material. This material is an assembly that the work order will rework. It is a primary key of the material.
(Required) Value that uniquely identifies the serial of the reworked assembly. It is a primary key that the application generates when it creates a serial.
The protocol version between a REST client and service. If the client does not specify this header in the request the server will pick a default version for the API.

If the REST API supports runtime customizations, the shape of the service may change during runtime. The REST client may isolate itself from these changes or choose to interact with the latest version of the API by specifying this header. For example: Metadata-Context:sandbox="TrackEmployeeFeature".

Used to define the starting position of the resource collection. If offset exceeds the resource count then no resources are returned. Default value is 0.

Format: ?q=expression1;expression2

You can use these queryable attributes to filter this collection resource using the q query parameter:
  • InventoryItemId; integer; Value that uniquely identifies the item, product, or assembly in the inventory organization.
  • LotNumber; string; Lot number of the reworked assembly.
  • OperationName; string; Name of the operation that references the serial number.
  • OperationSequenceNumber; number; Sequence to follow when performing work order operations that reference the serial number.
  • OrganizationId; integer; Value that uniquely identifies the inventory organization that's enabled for manufacturing. It is a primary key of the inventory organization.
  • SerialIssued; string; Status of the serial issued to the work order.
  • SerialNumber; string; Serial number that identifies the reworked assembly.
  • SerialReservationStatus; string; Reservation status of the work order.
  • SerialStatus; string; Status of the serial number that identifies the assembly referenced by this operation.
  • WoOperationMaterialId; integer; Value that uniquely identifies the reworked assembly. It is a primary key that the application generates when it creates the item.
  • WoOperationMaterialLotId; integer; Value that uniquely identifies the lot of the reworked assembly. It is a primary key that the application generates when it creates a lot.
  • WoOperationMaterialSerialId; integer; Value that uniquely identifies the serial of the reworked assembly. It is a primary key that the application generates when it creates a serial.
  • WorkCenterCode; string; Abbreviation that identifies the work center.
  • WorkCenterId; integer; Value that uniquely identifies the work center. It is the primary key generated by the application when the work center is created.
  • WorkCenterName; string; Name of the work center.
  • WorkOrderId; integer; Value that uniquely identifies the work order. It is a primary key that the application generates when it creates the work order.
  • WorkOrderOperationId; integer; Value that uniquely identifies the work order operation. It is the primary key generated by the application when the work order operation is created.

This parameter orders a resource collection based on the specified fields.  The parameter value is a comma-separated string of attribute names, each optionally followed by a colon and "asc" or "desc".  Specify "asc" for ascending and "desc" for descending. The default value is "asc".  For example, ?orderBy=field1:asc,field2:desc

Used as a predefined finder to search the collection.

Format: ?finder=<finderName>;<variableName>=<variableValue>,<variableName2>=<variableValue2>

The following are the available finder names and corresponding finder variables:

  • PrimaryKey: Finds rework work orders according to component serial issued to the rework order.
    Finder Variables:
    • WoOperationMaterialSerialId; integer; Primary key that uniquely identifies the component serial issued to the rework order. The application generates this primary key when it creates the serial. This attribute is required if the component is serial controlled.
  • WoSerialAltKey: Finds rework work order according to the specified component serial identifier.
    Finder Variables:
    • SerialNumber; string; Component serial number issued to the work order for rework.
    • WorkOrderId; integer; Value that uniquely identifies the rework work order. It is a primary key that the application generates when it creates the rework work order.

request.name: Reserve the serials of the rework work order

description.content: Reserves the serial numbers of the rework work order. To reserve the serial numbers, the client sends the work order identifier and the list of serial numbers to be reserved. The application then reserves the serial numbers based on their availability.

description.content: Performs midpoint rescheduling for the work order. If the plant must perform midpoint rescheduling, then the client sends the operation, date, and one of these scheduling options. 1, operation start date: the application sets the schedule date to the start date of the operation. 2, operation completion date: the application sets the schedule date to the completion date of the operation. The application then backward schedules the resources for operations that already occurred, and forward schedules the resources for subsequent operations. The application uses the work order operation as an anchor so that it can reschedule the resource according to the date that you specify. It uses this anchor as a stable, single reference point so that it can accurately reschedule the operations.

You can use these queryable attributes to filter this collection resource using the q query parameter:
  • ActualCompletionDate; string; Actual finish date of the work order. This date occurs when the work order status changes to Completed.
  • ActualStartDate; string; Actual start date of the work order.
  • BackToBackFlag; boolean; Contains one of the following values: true or false. If true, then the application created the work order as part of the back-to-back flow. If false, then application did not create the work order as part of the back-to-back flow. The default value is false.
  • CanceledDate; string; Date when the work order is canceled.
  • CanceledReason; string; Reason for canceling the work order.
  • ClosedDate; string; Date when the work order is closed.
  • CmPOHeaderId; integer; Value that uniquely identifies the purchase order header. It is a primary key that the application generates when it creates the purchase order header.
  • CmPOLineId; integer; Value that uniquely identifies the purchase order line. It is a primary key that the application generates when it creates the purchase order line.
  • CmPOLineLocId; integer; Value that uniquely identifies the purchase order line schedule. It is a primary key that the application generates when it creates the purchase order line schedule.
  • CompletedQuantity; number; Work order quantity that's completed into inventory at the last operation.
  • CompletionLocator; string; Completion locator to use, by default, when considering the work order for product completion.
  • CompletionLocatorId; integer; Value that uniquely identifies the locator. It is a primary key that the application generates when it creates the locator.
  • CompletionSubinventoryCode; string; Completion subinventory to use, by default, when considering the work order for product completion.
  • ConfigItemVersion; integer; Number that identifies the version of a one-time configured item.
  • ContractMfgFlag; boolean; Contains one of the following values: true or false. If true, then the work order was created as part of the contract manufacturing flow. If false, then the work order was not created as part of the contract manufacturing flow. The default value is false.
  • CreatedBy; string; User who created the work order.
  • CreationDate; string; Date when the user created the work order.
  • ExpeditedFlag; boolean; Indicates that the work order is expedited.
  • FirmPlannedFlag; boolean; Contains one of the following values: true or false. If true, then planning doesn't consider the work order when rescheduling or re-planning. If false, then planning can suggest rescheduling and re-planning recommendations with respect to the work order. The default value is false.
  • InterfaceSourceCode; string; Abbreviation that identifies the interface source.
  • InventoryItemId; integer; Value that uniquely identifies the item, product, or assembly in the inventory organization.
  • ItemNumber; string; Number that identifies the item, which is an output of the work order.
  • ItemRevision; string; Revision of the item that's in effect according to the work definition date of the work order.
  • ItemStructureName; string; Name of the item structure that the work definition on the work order references.
  • KanbanCardId; integer; Unique identifier of the Kanban card. Its value is an application-generated unique ID.
  • KanbanCardNumber; string; Number that uniquely identifies the Kanban card. Its value is generated from a document sequence.
  • KanbanReplenishmentCycleId; integer; Unique identifier of the current replenishment cycle.
  • LastUpdateDate; string; Date and time when the user most recently updated the work order.
  • LastUpdatedBy; string; Login of the user who most recently updated the work order.
  • NettableSupplyQuantityOverride; number; Quantity that the planning system uses as supply from the work order.
  • OneTimeConfigFlag; boolean; Contains one of the following values: Y or N. Y: Fulfill the item as a one-time configuration. N: Don't fulfill the item as a one-time configuration.
  • OrchestrationCode; string; Abbreviation that identifies the orchestration process that created the work order.
  • OrderLessFlag; boolean; Contains one of the following values: true or false. If true, then the application created the work order as part of a flow that doesn't have an order. If false, then the application did not create the work order as part of a flow that doesn't have an order. The default value is false.
  • OrganizationCode; string; Abbreviation that identifies the inventory organization that's enabled for manufacturing.

description.content: When this parameter is provided, the specified children are included in the resource payload (instead of just a link). The value of this query parameter is "all" or "". More than one child can be specified using comma as a separator. Example: ?expand=Employees,Localizations. Nested children can also be provided following the format "Child.NestedChild" (Example: ?expand=Employees.Managers). If a nested child is provided (Example: Employees.Managers), the missing children will be processed implicitly. For example, "?expand=Employees.Managers" is the same as "?expand=Employees,Employees.Managers" (which will expand Employees and Managers).

This parameter filters the resource fields. Only the specified fields are returned, which means that if no fields are specified, no fields are returned (useful to get only the links). If an indirect child resource is provided (Example: Employees.Managers), the missing children will be processed implicitly. For example, "?fields=Employees.Managers:Empname" is the same as "?fields=;Employees:;Employees.Managers:Empname" (which will only return the "Empname" field for Managers). the value of this query parameter is a list of resource fields. The attribute can be a direct (Example: Employees) or indirect (Example: Employees.Managers) child. It cannot be combined with expand query parameter. If both are provided, only fields will be considered.

Format: ?fields=Attribute1,Attribute2

Format for fields in child resource: ?fields=Accessor1:Attribute1,Attribute2
